core_categories: Medical Devices; Patient Handling Equipment; Hygiene Systems; Medical Beds; Pressure Injury Prevention; VTE Prevention
specialty_focus: Arjo is a global manufacturer and supplier of medical devices and solutions focused on patient mobility and clinical care. It specializes in patient handling, hygiene, medical beds, pressure injury prevention, and VTE prevention, serving acute care, long-term care, and bariatric care settings. Arjo sells directly in over 60 countries and through authorized distributors in other markets.
